senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; גָּלַל)roll, scroll, volume, part of a סֵפֶר.
units: Treat. Sof’rim V, 9 אין עושין שמע (או)הלל מ׳ וכ׳ you must not prepare the section of Sh’ma or of Hallel as a special volume for children; Gitt. 60ᵃ מהו לכתוב מ׳ וכ׳, v. לָמַד; Yoma 37ᵇ. Gitt. l. c. תורה מ׳ מ׳ ניתנה the Pentateuch was published in sections, opp. חתומה.
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 8:3">Deut. R. s. 8</cite> <he>תחלה קורא במ׳</he> when beginning, the student reads (the Pentateuch) in a detached scroll, opp. <he>בספר</he>.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 5:2:5">Y. Shek. V, 49ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Yoma 38a:15">Yoma 38ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:6:4">Cant. R. to III, 6</cite> <he>מְגִלַּת ס</he>(<cite ref="M00000"><he>מ</he></cite>)<he>מנין</he> a volume containing prescriptions for frankincense; a. fr.—<he>מ׳ יוחסין</he>, <he>מ׳ סתרים מגלת אסתר</he>, &c., v. respect. determinants.—Pl. <he>מְגִלּוֹת</he>, <cite ref="M02318"><he>מְגִילּוֹת</he></cite>. Cant. R. l. c. <he>היו מוסרין מְגִילּוֹתָם וכ׳</he> they handed over their rolls (containing the prescriptions) one to the other; (Y. Shek. l. c. <he>את המגלה הזאת</he>).—Esp. (<cite ref="U01971"><he>הַ</he></cite>)<cite ref="M00184"><he>מְּגִלָּה</he></cite> = <he>מגלת אסתר</he>, a. <cite ref="A02586"><he>אֶסְתֵּר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Megillah 19a:20">Ib. 19ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ נקראת ספר</he> the book of Esther is called a book and also a letter.

Ib., sq. הקורא במ׳ הכתובה בין וכ׳ he who recites from a Book of Esther as written among the Hagiographa (instead of using a special scroll); a. v. fr.—M’gillah, name of a treatise of the Mishnah, Tosefta, Talmud Babli a. Y’rushalmi, treating chiefly of the Festival of Purim.—M’gilloth, the five books: Esther, Ruth, Canticum, Lamentations and Koheleth.
